plan: Certified Memory Revalidation for LLM Agents at Model Migration, plan v1 (13 Nov 2026); plan v2 (docs/plan_v2.md) from notebook 02

revision_2.harness: AgentDojo default tool-use instructions; one call per reply; nested-call parser fallback; document names matched on letters and digits; calendar template reworded

revision_3.harness: rule: addresses and IBANs copied from a tool result or a saved memory about that person or payee, never constructed; one worked example of the reply format; system-prompt hash in the episode key

revision_4.harness: generation stops at the tool-result prefix ('Tool result for'), the convention of ReAct-style text protocols; the conversation keeps a reply only up to the end of the executed tool call; revision-3 episodes with no reply affected by either change are kept

revision_5.harness: a tool call identical to an earlier call of the same episode is not run again; the reader is given the earlier result and told to take the next step; up to 8 model calls per episode instead of 5; episodes of revisions 3 and 4 with no repeated call that did not run out of steps are kept

method.name: two-tier RLMA
method.sample: n0(alpha, delta/2) log queries, one sample for both tiers
method.labelled_tier: RLMA of amendment 1 (score with the provenance label, grid METHOD_GRID_SHARES, targeted census of CENSUS_UNITS units, whole-record quarantine), tested in order at delta/2
method.fallback_tier: entered only when K1 fails: the label-free candidates (NO_SOURCE_FEATURES, grid NO_SOURCE_GRID_SHARES, their own targeted census run then), tested in order at delta/2 on the same sample; reset when K'1 fails
method.guarantee: P(deployed r_Q > alpha) <= delta (union bound over the tiers)

scores.saved_models: reports/07_models/ loaded as they are: M1 s, M2 s, M7 s and s_ns
scores.refitted: M1 s_ns and M2 s_ns (not saved by notebook 07) on reports/05_training_units.csv.gz with the same recipe and seed; the largest difference from reports/05_units.csv.gz and the number of development units moved across a threshold are recorded (gradient-boosted trees train in float32 with parallel sums, so a refit is not bit-exact)
